DiscoveryRunArtifact.title: DiscoveryRunArtifact
DiscoveryRunArtifact.description: The full self-contained artifact of one problem-driven discovery run: run record + input + candidate pool + criteria + demands + roles + resolutions + organizations + evaluations + selection + gaps + ecosystem requests (verifiable end-to-end).

DiscoveryRun.title: DiscoveryRun
DiscoveryRun.description: One reproducible discovery run with a content-addressed id and digest-chained lineage (verified end-to-end by verifyDiscoveryRun).

CapabilityDiscoveryRecordVersion.title: CapabilityDiscoveryRecordVersion
CapabilityDiscoveryRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized discovery record (currently 1).

DiscoveryRunId.title: DiscoveryRunId
DiscoveryRunId.description: Content-addressed discovery run id: "discrun:" + 16 hex characters.

DiscoveryRunKind.title: DiscoveryRunKind
DiscoveryRunKind.description: Discovery run kind: problem-driven (stream A) or ecosystem (stream B).

DiscoveryTenantId.title: DiscoveryTenantId
DiscoveryTenantId.description: Tenant identifier: "tenant:" + lowercase slug (the W009 grammar, mirrored).

DiscoveryCompilerVersion.title: DiscoveryCompilerVersion
DiscoveryCompilerVersion.description: Version of the universal demand compiler + role synthesizer.

CapabilityDiscoveryContractVersion.title: CapabilityDiscoveryContractVersion
CapabilityDiscoveryContractVersion.description: Version of the published capability-discovery contract surface.

DiscoveryRunTrigger.title: DiscoveryRunTrigger
DiscoveryRunTrigger.description: The trigger record on a run (manual, gap, scheduled, or event).

DiscoveryTrigger.title: DiscoveryTrigger
DiscoveryTrigger.description: What triggered a discovery run: manual, gap, scheduled, or event.

DiscoveryStageLink.title: DiscoveryStageLink
DiscoveryStageLink.description: One link of a run's digest chain: stage name, stage digest, previous stage digest.

DiscoveryStageName.title: DiscoveryStageName
DiscoveryStageName.description: Lineage stage name: inputs, demands, roles, resolution, organizations, evaluation, selection, candidates, gap-updates, promotions.

DiscoveryTimestamp.title: DiscoveryTimestamp
DiscoveryTimestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (caller-supplied; never wall-clock).

DiscoveryInput.title: DiscoveryInput
DiscoveryInput.description: The complete provider-neutral discovery input (task/world/evidence/constraint signals + pack contributions); every derivation is a deterministic function of this document.

TaskDescription.title: TaskDescription
TaskDescription.description: The task heading a discovery input: summary, universal lifecycle stage, domain refs, objectives.

UniversalLifecycleStage.title: UniversalLifecycleStage
UniversalLifecycleStage.description: The eleven universal lifecycle stages (USL1.0, mirrored closed union).

WorldRef.title: WorldRef
WorldRef.description: Opaque reference to an affected world/solution/delivery identity (id + content digest; never an embedded copy).

EvidenceSignal.title: EvidenceSignal
EvidenceSignal.description: Evidence signal: a content-addressed observation about the problem (digest + kind + subjects).

ConstraintSignal.title: ConstraintSignal
ConstraintSignal.description: Constraint signal: a provider-neutral constraint binding on the task (hard/soft/authority/budget/quality/interface).

TaskSignal.title: TaskSignal
TaskSignal.description: One universal task/problem signal (kind + summary + operation pin + subject/evidence/constraint references + neutral hints and kind-specific payloads).

TaskSignalKind.title: TaskSignalKind
TaskSignalKind.description: Universal task/problem signal kind: operation, decision, verification, artifact, quality, unknown, failure, work, budget, environment, authority, dependency, outcome.

OperationRef.title: OperationRef
OperationRef.description: Provider-neutral operation reference: dot-namespaced qualified id plus a version constraint (semver core or "*").

RepresentationKind.title: RepresentationKind
RepresentationKind.description: Neutral representation/modality kind: text, numeric, tabular, geometry, image, signal, document, structured, code.

QualityTarget.title: QualityTarget
QualityTarget.description: Quality/fidelity target: metric, threshold, unit, and direction (min/max).

MoneyAmount.title: MoneyAmount
MoneyAmount.description: Cost budget/estimate: ISO 4217 currency code + non-negative decimal amount string.

DomainPackContribution.title: DomainPackContribution
DomainPackContribution.description: A domain pack's reusable discovery knowledge (demand templates, role templates, signal bindings) — compiler priors, never a second compiler authority.

CapabilityDemandTemplate.title: CapabilityDemandTemplate
CapabilityDemandTemplate.description: Reusable capability-demand template from a domain pack (a PRIOR: may only add demands or tighten universal facets; never overrides).

TemplateApplicability.title: TemplateApplicability
TemplateApplicability.description: When a domain-pack template applies (matched against task signal kinds, domain refs, lifecycle stages).

RoleTemplate.title: RoleTemplate
RoleTemplate.description: Reusable role template from a domain pack: proposes a grouping of demand templates (considered by the universal compiler, never authoritative).

TaskSignalBinding.title: TaskSignalBinding
TaskSignalBinding.description: Domain-pack binding: this signal kind (+ optional domain) implies this demand template.

CandidateProfile.title: CandidateProfile
CandidateProfile.description: Provider-neutral candidate profile: claimed capabilities + provenance only (never a name-to-role mapping); external candidates are non-consequential until the promotion gates pass.

CandidateKind.title: CandidateKind
CandidateKind.description: Candidate nature: agent, human, capability, or external.

ClaimedCapability.title: ClaimedCapability
ClaimedCapability.description: A candidate's claim to one operation, with neutral input/output representation kinds and quality claim basis.

ClaimBasis.title: ClaimBasis
ClaimBasis.description: Basis of a capability claim: measured or declared.

LatencyClaim.title: LatencyClaim
LatencyClaim.description: Declared latency characteristics in whole milliseconds (p95 >= p50).

CostClaim.title: CostClaim
CostClaim.description: Declared cost characteristics: ISO 4217 currency, decimal amount, neutral basis.

CandidateProvenance.title: CandidateProvenance
CandidateProvenance.description: Where a candidate comes from (source class + content digest; provider identity stays adapter metadata).

CandidateEvaluationState.title: CandidateEvaluationState
CandidateEvaluationState.description: Candidate evaluation lifecycle (CC1.0): discovered, ingested, sandboxed, profiled, evaluated, verified, deprecated, retired.

CandidateSecurity.title: CandidateSecurity
CandidateSecurity.description: Security posture at the ingestion boundary: sandbox requirement, trust domain, notes.

EvaluationCriterion.title: EvaluationCriterion
EvaluationCriterion.description: One declared evaluation criterion (objective/constraint/evidence) bound to a neutral metric.

EvaluationCriterionKind.title: EvaluationCriterionKind
EvaluationCriterionKind.description: Declared evaluation criterion kind: hard-constraint, objective, or evidence-coverage.

EvaluationMetric.title: EvaluationMetric
EvaluationMetric.description: Deterministic organization-evaluation metric: demand-coverage, unmet-demand-count, evidence-coverage, redundancy-coverage, estimated-latency, estimated-cost, gap-count, critical-single-point-count.

CapabilityDemandSet.title: CapabilityDemandSet
CapabilityDemandSet.description: The sealed, canonically-ordered demand set of one run (content-addressed set digest).

CapabilityDemand.title: CapabilityDemand
CapabilityDemand.description: Provider-neutral capability demand: operation, outcome, I/O representations, quality target, uncertainty, evidence, tools, environment, budgets, authority constraints, dependencies, stage, affected identities, derivation provenance.

CapabilityDemandId.title: CapabilityDemandId
CapabilityDemandId.description: Content-addressed capability demand id: "demand:" + 16 hex characters.

OutputContractEntry.title: OutputContractEntry
OutputContractEntry.description: One entry of a demand output contract: name + representation kind.

DemandAuthorityConstraints.title: DemandAuthorityConstraints
DemandAuthorityConstraints.description: Authority constraints on a demand: executionAuthority admits exactly "none" (structurally inexpressible); optional human-cosign requirement.

RoleProposal.title: RoleProposal
RoleProposal.description: A candidate role synthesized by the universal compiler from demand evidence (no predefined role/model pair; slug derived from member operations, never a model name).

RoleProposalId.title: RoleProposalId
RoleProposalId.description: Content-addressed role proposal id: "drole:" + 16 hex characters.

RoleInterfaceEntry.title: RoleInterfaceEntry
RoleInterfaceEntry.description: A role interface entry (derived from member demand contracts): name + representation kind.

RolePlanningBehavior.title: RolePlanningBehavior
RolePlanningBehavior.description: Derived planning/delegation behavior of a candidate role.

RoleAuthorityBoundary.title: RoleAuthorityBoundary
RoleAuthorityBoundary.description: The authority boundary of a synthesized role: executionAuthority admits exactly "none" (the W003 convention — discovery never grants execution authority).

RoleProvenance.title: RoleProvenance
RoleProvenance.description: Provenance of a synthesized role: member demands, consulted/overridden pack templates, compiler version.

RoleResolution.title: RoleResolution
RoleResolution.description: The resolution of one role proposal against the candidate pool (assignments + unmet demands + opened gaps).

CandidateAssignment.title: CandidateAssignment
CandidateAssignment.description: One candidate bound to one role across matched/claimed/incompatible demands with a deterministic score.

CapabilityGapId.title: CapabilityGapId
CapabilityGapId.description: Content-addressed capability gap id: "gap:" + 16 hex characters.

OrganizationProposal.title: OrganizationProposal
OrganizationProposal.description: A candidate organization: role bindings, handoff topology, supervision, redundancy, estimates; staged organizations bind unverified candidates and can never be selected.

OrganizationId.title: OrganizationId
OrganizationId.description: Content-addressed organization proposal id: "org:" + 16 hex characters.

OrganizationRoleBinding.title: OrganizationRoleBinding
OrganizationRoleBinding.description: One role binding inside a candidate organization: primary candidate, backups, carried gaps.

HandoffEdge.title: HandoffEdge
HandoffEdge.description: A handoff edge between two roles (one output feeding one input of a shared representation kind).

SupervisionEdge.title: SupervisionEdge
SupervisionEdge.description: A supervision/escalation edge attached to a role (human review, peer review, or automated check).

OrganizationEstimates.title: OrganizationEstimates
OrganizationEstimates.description: Rollup estimates for an organization (deterministic sums; null when undeclared).

OrganizationEvaluation.title: OrganizationEvaluation
OrganizationEvaluation.description: The evaluation of one candidate organization under declared criteria (hard constraints, objectives, evidence coverage).

CriterionResult.title: CriterionResult
CriterionResult.description: The computed value of one criterion for one organization (null value when undeclared).

OrganizationSelection.title: OrganizationSelection
OrganizationSelection.description: The selection (or staging) outcome over evaluated organizations.

CapabilityGap.title: CapabilityGap
CapabilityGap.description: An explicit capability gap with the ARCD1.0 lifecycle and an append-only, tamper-detecting transition chain.

CapabilityGapState.title: CapabilityGapState
CapabilityGapState.description: Capability-gap lifecycle: UNSATISFIED, CANDIDATE_FOUND, EVALUATED, VERIFIED, DEGRADED, REQUIRES_HUMAN.

GapTransition.title: GapTransition
GapTransition.description: One append-only, hash-linked capability-gap state transition (content-addressed).

EcosystemDiscoveryRequest.title: EcosystemDiscoveryRequest
EcosystemDiscoveryRequest.description: A request for ecosystem discovery derived from unsatisfied capability gaps.
